bar_impact.core.masks

Survey mask data structures for BAR_IMPACT.

This module provides the SurveyMask class for representing and creating survey footprint masks for partial-sky analysis.

Functions

clear_mask_cache()

Clear the global mask cache.

get_cached_mask([nside, target_area_sqdeg, ...])

Get a cached mask, creating it if necessary.

Classes

SurveyMask(data[, nside, area_sqdeg, f_sky, ...])

Survey footprint mask for partial-sky analysis.
class bar_impact.core.masks.SurveyMask(data, nside=None, area_sqdeg=None, f_sky=None, center_coords=None, apodization_deg=0.0, angular_radius_deg=None)[source]

Bases: object

Survey footprint mask for partial-sky analysis.

This class represents a binary or weighted mask that defines the survey footprint. It supports various mask geometries and apodization schemes.

Parameters:

  • data (np.ndarray) – HEALPix mask array. Values should be in [0, 1] where 0 = masked and 1 = unmasked.

  • nside (int, optional) – HEALPix resolution. Inferred from data if not provided.

  • area_sqdeg (float, optional) – Effective survey area in square degrees.

  • f_sky (float, optional) – Fraction of sky covered. Computed from data if not provided.

  • center_coords (Tuple[float, float], optional) – Center coordinates (lon, lat) in degrees.

  • apodization_deg (float, optional) – Apodization width in degrees (0 if not apodized).

  • angular_radius_deg (float | None)

npix

Number of pixels in the mask.

Type:

int

Examples

>>> mask = SurveyMask.create_disk_mask(
...     nside=512,
...     target_area_sqdeg=14000.0,
...     center_coords=(0.0, 90.0)
... )
>>> mask.f_sky
0.339...

>>> # Apply to a map
>>> masked_map = np.where(mask.data > 0, kappa_map, 0)

classmethod create_disk_mask(nside=512, target_area_sqdeg=14000.0, center_coords=(0.0, 90.0), use_cache=True)[source]

Create a circular (disk) mask on the sphere.

This creates a spherical cap mask centered at the specified coordinates with an area matching the target.

Parameters:

  • nside (int, optional) – HEALPix resolution (default: 512).

  • target_area_sqdeg (float, optional) – Target unmasked area in square degrees (default: 14000).

  • center_coords (Tuple[float, float], optional) – Center (lon, lat) in degrees (default: (0, 90) = North Pole).

  • use_cache (bool, optional) – Whether to use cached masks (default: True).

Returns:

Circular survey mask.

Return type:

SurveyMask

Notes

For a spherical cap with solid angle Ω, the angular radius θ satisfies: Ω = 2π(1 - cos(θ))

Examples

>>> mask = SurveyMask.create_disk_mask(
...     nside=512,
...     target_area_sqdeg=14000.0
... )
>>> print(f"f_sky = {mask.f_sky:.3f}")
f_sky = 0.339
classmethod create_apodized_disk_mask(nside=512, target_area_sqdeg=14000.0, center_coords=(0.0, 90.0), apodization_deg=2.0, apodization_type='C1', use_cache=True)[source]

Create an apodized (smooth edge) circular mask.

The mask smoothly transitions from 1 to 0 over the apodization region at the mask boundary.

Parameters:

  • nside (int, optional) – HEALPix resolution.

  • target_area_sqdeg (float, optional) – Target unmasked area.

  • center_coords (Tuple[float, float], optional) – Center (lon, lat) in degrees.

  • apodization_deg (float, optional) – Width of the apodization region in degrees (default: 2.0).

  • apodization_type (str, optional) – Type of apodization: ‘C1’ (cosine taper) or ‘C2’ (polynomial). C2 is recommended for power spectrum analysis (default: ‘C1’).

  • use_cache (bool, optional) – Whether to use cached masks.

Returns:

Apodized circular mask.

Return type:

SurveyMask

Notes

Apodization helps reduce edge effects in power spectrum estimation.

C1 (cosine taper): Smooth but not twice differentiable

\[w(x) = \frac{1}{2}\left[1 + \cos(\pi x)\right]\]

C2 (polynomial): Twice differentiable, better for power spectra

\[\begin{split}w(x) = \begin{cases} 1 - 2x^2 & x < 0.5 \\ 2(1-x)^2 & x \geq 0.5 \end{cases}\end{split}\]

where x is the normalized distance within the transition region.
